name: Saura Filter Pith

Organic texture, not fired clay, no hungry mouth or carnivorous plant. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, exquisite tactile detail and believable natural material behaviour, late industrial craft atmosphere. Landscape 3:2. One coherent close-up scene of this ONE material, with raw or worked examples of that same material only where requested; not a composite board of different materials. Use light and background suited to this specific material so its texture, silhouette and colour are immediately legible. No people, no readable letters or numerals, no labels, logo, watermark, card frame or infographic. Do not add supernatural effects to ordinary material. No extra tools or props that could be mistaken for a different catalogue specimen.
visual_caption: Campione illustrativo di Saura Filter Pith. Forma, colore e finitura aiutano a riconoscere il materiale; non certificano da soli purezza, provenienza o investimento.
